name: Statistical area type
description: What kind of area something is when it has no governing authority of its own. Worded to work in any country. A national agency's own name for the tier (census tract, output area, IRIS) goes in an identifier or alternateName, not a new term.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Statistical area
hasDefinedTerm.description: An area drawn by a statistical agency to tabulate data, such as a census tract or output area.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Designated place
hasDefinedTerm.description: A named, populated place that a statistical agency recognises but that is not a governed municipality.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Postal area
hasDefinedTerm.description: An area derived from postal delivery codes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Planning area
hasDefinedTerm.description: An area a government uses for planning, with no governing body of its own.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Service area
hasDefinedTerm.description: The area a service, facility or programme covers, where that is not a jurisdiction.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Community area
hasDefinedTerm.description: A government-defined grouping of neighbourhoods or statistical areas used to report community data.
